sum: Bonk, Inc. provides over-the-counter products and consumer products in the United States. The company offers Safety Shot Beverage, an over-the-counter drink that lowers blood alcohol content to allow recovery from the effects of alcohol by supporting its metabolism. It also provides hair loss treatment, vitiligo solution, and sexual wellness products. The company sells its products through direct customers, distributors, retailers, and e-commerce websites. The company was formerly known as Safety Shot, Inc. and changed its name to Bonk, Inc. in October 2025. Bonk, Inc. was incorporated in 2018 and is headquartered in Scottsdale, Arizona.
